about: ek1 (Noah 10/17): every 25th Anniversary team wears the uniform it wore in that game. Where an existing kit matches the game (89 of 102 sides; two switch to a better existing kit) the moment keeps or switches to it; where none does, a NEW style index is added for the franchise (never a replacement): two kit packages composed from existing kits of the build copy (whole kits, colour-swapped H/A sets, or chunk mixes), nine aggregate card members renamed from existing ones, and a year pair in the moment's team file only, so modern Team Select never offers the new index. References: Gridiron Uniform Database per-game graphics and Super Bowl XLII broadcast frames, kept in ek1 scratch, never shipped.
free_index_rule: a new style is a free index: no kit package and no aggregate member with that (asset code, style) on the build copy

classic_defaults_note: Quick Game classic-team default (team +0x192) of the moment team files, so a classic team's main uniform is the one it wore in its moment (Noah 10/17). Files whose moment side wears the 2026 kit (style 0) keep their byte: historic_styles moves every style-0 historic file to its franchise spare. Files used by several moments keep their byte unless listed.
